author: Haruko
name: BattleMetric
short: BattleMetrics API and HLL: Vietnam RCON helper cog.
description: Modular Redbot cog for BattleMetrics server data, automatic Server Info panels, and a pooled HLL: Vietnam RCON kill feed.
install_msg: BattleMetric loaded. Use [p]help battlemetric, [p]help serverinfo, or [p]help killfeed to see commands.
end_user_data_statement: Reads global BattleMetrics and HLL RCON secrets from Red's shared API-token storage and stores per-guild settings, including Server Info panel IDs, HLL RCON endpoint and kill-feed channel settings, and authorized Discord user IDs.
